name: Mathura
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Government of Uttar Pradesh public cadastral digitization dashboard includes Mathura district tehsils and village map counts; the official viewer provides Mathura/Sadar revenue-village selectors. This confirms a local cadastral record service.
remainingUncertainty: Which Sadar revenue-village map covers the WUP population-weighted point; map extent rectangles do not establish parcel containment. The public viewer displays cadastral parcels, but a complete native feature response at the exact city point was not obtained.
scopeLimits: No citywide completeness is asserted. No owner/address/account/token values retained. At most three complete native parcel geometries may be retained for this city; none was obtained.

technicalBlocker: Public Mathura Sadar selectors and map extents respond, but the WUP center’s revenue-village coverage was not resolved. A click query using Mathura Bangar’s GIS code at the exact WUP coordinate returned an empty JSON object; its map extent begins north of the WUP point. No polygon was retained.
